**Finding: deviation (medium) — § 12.4 non-solicitation binding Customer**

§ 12.4 imposes a one-way, 18-month restriction on us covering *any* person employed by Vendor at any time during the term, and prohibits "engag[ing]" them (an effective no-hire), with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. It also directly conflicts with § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

**Redline (validated, preferred):** delete § 12.4 in full. Fallback offered in the comment — mutual covenant limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
